brand.semantic.identity.one_liner: Affordable trend-led streetwear for India's Gen-Z, dropping new styles weekly.
brand.semantic.identity.target_customer: 18-26 year olds in metro and tier-2 cities, price-sensitive, discovers styles through Reels and influencer hauls, shops in bursts around drops/sales/festive occasions.

brand.semantic.competitors.name: Snitch
brand.semantic.competitors.positioning_note: Similar Gen-Z streetwear category, slightly higher AOV.

market_memory.patterns.pattern_statement: Creator/customer-style short-form video content tends to outperform polished static product imagery on engagement.
Adding explicit size/fit reassurance (try-on video, size-chart callout, fit guide) to the product page tends to reduce cart abandonment.

axes.y_axis: Trend Relevance / Style Focus (Niche vs. Broad)

brief.whitespace_summary: There is whitespace in the 'Ultra-Affordable, Hyper-Current Trend Delivery' quadrant. Competitors occupy either a slightly higher price point (Snitch) or a broader/niche focus (The Souled Store). The opportunity lies in owning the intersection of extreme budget pricing and immediate trend access.
brief.positioning_summary: Vamp should position itself as the most accessible gateway for Gen Z to acquire weekly, cutting-edge streetwear trends without compromising on budget, emphasizing speed and trend immediacy over broad catalog depth or deep fandom focus.

tone.voice_notes: Talks like a friend hyping the next drop, not a catalog. Leans on countdowns, emoji, creator-style captions.

constraints.product: Focus on weekly, cutting-edge streetwear drops; emphasize trend immediacy over catalog depth.
constraints.price: Reinforce budget accessibility; avoid any language suggesting discounts or sales.
constraints.place: D2C focus; content must be optimized for Instagram/Reels native formats.
constraints.promotion: Use urgency-driven, slang-friendly, meme-literate language. Focus on 'the drop' rather than 'the sale.' No discount code call-outs in headlines.
constraints.people: Adopt a voice that sounds like a friend hyping the next drop; use creator-style captions and emojis.
constraints.physical_evidence: Prioritize UGC video content over static imagery. Include explicit size/fit reassurance elements (e.g., fit guides, try-on videos) to reduce friction.
constraints.process: Emphasize speed and immediacy of acquisition. The experience must feel like catching a limited drop, not browsing a slow catalog.
hard_rules: No discount code call-outs in the headline
Keep this capsule to feel like a drop not a sale
Do not imply limited stock we cannot back
Keep it Instagram/Reels-native, not stiff catalog copy
